parse_thinking_output: parse Gemma4 model decoded text to extract thinking reasoning and final answer into a dict
strip_thought_label: strip the spurious thought label prefix from the start of Gemma4 model output text
clean_answer: clean trailing sentinel tokens like turn-end and eos markers from Gemma4 model answer text
parse_thinking_output_with_vllm: parse vLLM offline inference output from Gemma4 model using parse_thinking_output on decoded tokens
parse_thinking_output_without_thinking_m: parse Gemma4 output that has no thinking delimiters by stripping spurious labels and cleaning sentinels
